overloadMerges.note: arrText is an output array filled by the command (parameter table marks it '<-'); autoparse defaulted every parameter to direction:in. Documents that the trailing '*' flag switches to multistyle mode, in which case width/fontName/fontSize/fontStyle are ignored.

params.name: arrText
params.description: Array filled with the text divided into words or lines

params.name: width
params.description: Maximum width of string (in pixels); mandatory for raw (non-multistyle) text

params.name: fontName
params.description: Name of font; mandatory for raw (non-multistyle) text

params.name: fontSize
params.description: Size of font; mandatory for raw (non-multistyle) text
If passed, interpret varText as multistyle text; width/fontName/fontSize/fontStyle are then ignored, since the original per-run styles are used and preserved in arrText's elements instead.

constraints: Each arrText element must contain at least one word; if width is too small for a word to fit, the array is filled as close as possible to the requested width and the OK system variable is set to 0.
For raw (non-multistyle) text, width, fontName, and fontSize are mandatory so the command can measure line lengths.
